period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) vs 31-Dec-2017. Income-statement items recorded here are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2018 (9-month YTD); the source also independently discloses discrete 3-month (Jul-Sep 2018) figures (net loss after tax BDT -151.05m), not stored as separate line items. SOLO/STANDALONE basis. Source PDF is a scanned filing; extracted via OCR (pdftoppm 300dpi -> tesseract 5.5.3). Cross-checks: 31-Dec-2017 comparative matches 2017_Q4.json; the 9M-2017 and Q3-2017-discrete comparative columns in this file (total operating income 61,055,531 / 11,630,656; total operating expenses 341,565,452 / 102,710,000; operating profit -280,509,920 / -91,079,344; PAT -281,374,813 / -98,876,269) match 2017_Q3.json's own figures exactly; this filing's own Statement of Changes in Equity independently reproduces 'Balance as at 30 September 2017' as retained earnings -17,606,211,136 / equity -10,326,426,253, confirming the figures reconstructed in 2017_Q3.json. Income-statement chain closes exactly (A-B=C; provision D re-derived as C minus PBT = -14,394,721 for 9M-2018, a net recovery, decomposing into Q1-2018's -16,702,875 recovery plus small Q2/Q3 charges; PBT-tax=PAT with tax=0; PAT/664,702,300 shares=EPS -0.54). SAME 'Prior year adjustment' (~13,396,230 taka) as noted in 2018_Q2.json appears again in this filing's Statement of Changes in Equity, restating the 1-January-2018 opening balance without that restatement being reflected in this filing's own Balance Sheet comparative column (which still shows the original -17,731,371,664 / -10,451,586,781, matching 2017_Q4.json, left unmodified).
